process: Deck agents performed two individual reference comparison/correction rounds. Main agent individually reviewed all 109 final replica/reference pairs, repaired four pages, and checked final assembly pixel parity. All 23 non-identical assembly/reference pairs were individually reviewed. Exact 86 inherit the same reviewed pixels. Targeted repairs were re-exported and automatically checked.
repairs: 091/05: reserve label content padding for four cost-pill icons; visual center measured within content area.
094/18: reduce note heading to 18px to avoid its body.
098/15: increase card body contrast and weight.
Assembly compiler: preserve foreground headings/chart labels over panels and SVG using conservative paint-order ownership.
Library chart-donut: constrain width by available height so full and minimum examples remain circular.

libraryReview.donutAfterRepair: Full/minimum, light/dark re-rendered and individually viewed.
